description: This file defines a PHP class that serves as a client for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime service, providing method signatures for various operations such as getting and putting records.

classes.name: SageMakerFeatureStoreRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class for interfacing with Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime API, extending the AwsClient class.

methods.name: batchGetRecord
methods.description: Retrieves multiple records from the feature store.

methods.name: batchGetRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple records from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a record from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a record from the feature store.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific record from the feature store.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Stores a record into the feature store.

methods.name: putRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a record into the feature store.
